description_en: Queries the list of resources for the current account
description_zh: 查询当前账号资源列表
kebab_example: aliyun config list-discovered-resources --resource-id eni-hp31cqoba96jagtz0000 --resource-deleted 1 --page-size 1 --page-number 10 --resource-types ACS::ECS::NetworkInterface --regions cn-huhehaote --multi-account false --member-id 1208863412610000 --api-version 2019-01-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDiscoveredResources

parameters.help_en:
Resource status. Valid values:

0: Deleted.

1 (default): Active

parameters.name: resource_deleted
